# Joy Irine Barnayha — Automation & AI Architect

> Joy Irine Barnayha is an Automation & AI Architect who designs and builds automation systems, AI agents, and workflow solutions that run businesses on autopilot, 24 hours a day. She works with GoHighLevel, Make.com, n8n, Zapier, Claude AI, Vapi, and ElevenLabs.

Joy helps businesses eliminate manual work through smart systems, AI agents, and integrations — from GoHighLevel CRM setup and Make.com automation workflows to AI voice agents and digital twins. Clients do not need technical knowledge; she handles the full setup end-to-end, from strategy to build. Projects start with a free call, and pricing depends on project scope.

## Services

- GHL Setup & Management: full GoHighLevel CRM setup — pipelines, funnels, calendars, automations, sub-accounts
- Make.com Automation: custom scenarios connecting apps and automating complex multi-step workflows
- Zapier Workflows: automations connecting 5,000+ apps
- AI Phone Assistant: 24/7 AI voice agents that answer inbound calls, qualify leads, book appointments, and handle FAQs
- AI Integration: voice AI agents, chatbots, and digital twins built with Claude AI, Vapi, and ElevenLabs
- Landing Pages & Funnels: high-converting landing pages and sales funnels in GHL or custom HTML

## Tools

GoHighLevel, Make.com, Zapier, n8n, Claude AI, Vapi.ai, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT, Zoho CRM, Airtable, Notion, Google Workspace, HTML/CSS, CapCut, HeyGen, Canva
